configurations.name: omniflow-console-demo
runtimeArgs: rm -rf /tmp/omniflow-console-demo && OMNIFLOW_DATA_DIR=/tmp/omniflow-console-demo OMNIFLOW_PORT=18080 OMNIFLOW_HOST=127.0.0.1 OMNIFLOW_PUBLIC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18080 OMNIFLOW_ENV=development OMNIFLOW_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com OMNIFLOW_ADMIN_PASSWORD=correct-horse-battery-staple OMNIFLOW_LOG_LEVEL=warn OMNIFLOW_SHELL_ALLOWED_COMMANDS=/usr/bin/curl exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/main.ts

configurations.name: omniflow-nexora-demo
runtimeArgs: rm -rf /tmp/omniflow-nexora-demo && OMNIFLOW_MODE=nexora OMNIFLOW_NEXORA_CORE=fake OMNIFLOW_DATA_DIR=/tmp/omniflow-nexora-demo OMNIFLOW_PORT=18082 OMNIFLOW_HOST=127.0.0.1 OMNIFLOW_PUBLIC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18082 OMNIFLOW_ENV=development OMNIFLOW_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com OMNIFLOW_ADMIN_PASSWORD=correct-horse-battery-staple OMNIFLOW_LOG_LEVEL=warn exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning server/main.ts
